title: Rav Kahana bar Bizna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yalkut, Ezekiel, remez 347](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.347.1), he said in the name of Rabbi Shimon Chasida (א״ר שמעון חסידא): “Were it not that the coals had cooled,” etc. Hyman calls this a scribal error, for the statement comes from [Yoma 77a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.77a.3), and there it is Rav Chana bar Bizna.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Yoma 77a has Rav Chana bar Bizna reporting Rabbi Shimon Chasida. Kahana is Hyman’s heading for the reading he rejects; the transmission and Hyman’s emendation remain distinct.

The linked Yalkut gives Rabbi Kahana bar Bizna in Rabbi Shimon Chasida’s name. The linked Bavli gives Rav Chana bar Bizna in the same transmission, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1378&lang=en) cites the latter. Hyman attributes the Kahana form to a scribal error.
